notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Sins of the Floating City. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/fbf8267353a5507ad8ab002b19eec99774c9ea3f.png"]

Hello everyone!

We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's fourth DLC — Sins of the Floating City. It is scheduled to be released on September 4th 10am PDT and will continue to expand the world and story of HWR. This time with two new massive story branches that will be taking place in Italy during Venice-Genoa wars. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch containing new items, gameplay mechanics, updated balancing and lots of technical iprovements.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City"][/dynamiclink]
What awaits you in the DLC:

*No step too far, no measure too desperate
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

*A descent into darkness
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/badef4b721b81d14272c5722cff02a99c10b10c7.jpg"]

*More than a dozen new characters
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

*Europe-spanning adventure
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

*2 new romantic interests
Each with their own unique story and character.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/de5a0f1403bd320b2b6a6b6698af6a006edf6ad3.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/1243e4136a45c7845858c8fafd31d6732032bab6.jpg"]

As always together with the DLC we will be releasing a big gameplay update that will, among other things, include:

• new mechanics, items, weapons and civic talents;

• improved survival mode;

• a lot of bugfixes and several performance improvements;

notes.title: Global Update 1.1 - Progress report 3
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30216394/259bfadafcb365b37d6c6764944b86b6fa99f12c.jpg

Dear friends,

As I wrote earlier, we are a little late with the release of the update. Since the game had to be completely remade, testing the game mechanics took a lot longer than I thought. 

At the moment everything works fine, but the gameplay itself is a bit ... hardcore. We are working on the difficulty settings to play was more comfortable.

What we need to do:
-savegames testing
-balancing difficulty levels
-some tweaks

We will be keep you posted.

Casualogic team.

notes.title: Global Update 1.1 - Progress report 2
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30216394/b488c2f3d3b0e99ed5ad3c0edfc5e1f898809df5.jpg
Dear friends,

As we said earlier, we get out of the schedule (2 months). We have a real chance to finish everything by the end of June. Thank you for your patience. New feature that we just added to the game:

-Contracts. These are the goals that the player must reach to complete the current mission. Collect resources, obtain scientific data etc.

What we need to do:

-Main menu/Mission selector/Options
-Scenario missions
-Tutorial mission
-Some testing

We will keep you informed.

notes.title: Global Update 1.1 - Progress Report
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30216394/46f9954d1bed6bc4632aaa6300480a29c2feb8d1.jpg

Dear friends,

Just want to inform you that the work on the global update is coming to an end. There is still a lot of work here and it seems that we are lagging behind the schedule (as we originally said - 2 months). Here is list of changes already implemented:

-New game engine (OpenGL 3.0) No more old crashes and strange critical bugs.

-Full UI redesign (most of controls now is more clear and intuitive)

-Station visual look improvements (no empty corridors, 2d lights)

-New station crew control UI and mechanics (now each crew member to do his work must be attached to station module(s). This innovation removes all the problems about late and incorrect delivery of resources, confusion when distributing characters to workplaces, etc.

-New map resource - Ice. From ice you can produce water. Water needed in greenhouse and for beverages production (for crew).

-New resources for production - Water and Beverages.
-Defense platforms now use ammunition

-Full redesign Greenhouse/Farm/Manufacturing plant control

-Strong changes in Research tree and science mechanics

-New messaging system. No more tons of log messages. Just sorted and clear popup messages under main panel.

-Day|Night cycle.

-New station module - Station Shield Generator. Designed to protect the station from asteroids.

Thank you for patience.

notes.title: Global update 1.1 - work in progress
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Sorry for long delay. We have finally started work on a global update of our game. What does it mean?

-New game engine (OpenGL-based)
-No more crashes
-No any compatability issues
-Localization bugfixes
-Greatly improved perfomance
-Any resolution support, vsync support
-Full UI redesign
-UI improvements (zoom system, detailed free game options etc.)
-Strong gameplay changes (full rebalance, new mechanics, less micromanagement, more fun)

We have plans to complete this in 1-2 month. Thank you for you patience.

Casualogic team
